plugin.name: idavim
plugin.description:
Vim-style keyboard navigation for IDA Pro, inspired by Vimium and IdeaVim.
Navigate the disassembly and Hex-Rays pseudocode views with hjkl, u/d half-page scrolling, gg/G, line jumps ({n}G and :30 in the pseudocode view), f/F character find, / search with n/N, word motions and counts, plus cw to rename the identifier under the cursor. Press Shift+Esc to toggle the plugin on and off.
